If you finish the story with trophies outstanding, free-roam cleanup covers everything that is not flagged missable.
steps: Follow the roadmap stages 1–6 in order and tick each trophy off here as it pops.
Before starting Chapter 3 and again before the final mission, check the Missable filter and clear anything still open.
When only this platinum remains, earn the last missing trophy — the platinum pops immediately after it.

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single activation of Combat Focus. Setup is everything: find a dense enemy group (a gang operation or a story shootout with clustered enemies), position so all five are visible, then trigger Combat Focus and drop them before it ends. If you only get three or four, reload or find a new group — partial progress does not carry between activations. Weapon choice matters: a fast, accurate weapon with a full magazine avoids a mid-focus reload. Not missable; enemy groups respawn in free roam.
steps: Find a clustered group of at least 5 enemies (gang operations work well).
Position with all five in view and a full magazine ready.
Activate Combat Focus and take down all five before it ends.

Rob the vault and escape until the wanted level clears.
Repeat at 5 banks (repeats count only on successful escapes).

If you rush the story and skip optional choice points, you can finish below the threshold with no way to add choices afterwards. Engage with choice prompts throughout the story instead of skipping dialogue.
trophies.guide: Make choices — for better or worse. This trophy tracks the story choices you make (PlayStation's tracking counts toward 500), so the method is simply to engage: when the game presents a choice, choose deliberately instead of skipping dialogue or letting timers expire. Players who rush cutscenes can end the story short of the threshold with no post-story way to add choices, which is why this is flagged missable in spirit: the choices live in the story, and the story only happens once per playthrough. A normal, engaged playthrough earns it without grinding.
steps: Never skip story dialogue that contains a choice prompt.
Make a deliberate selection at every choice point (either option counts).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableWhen: Requires failing something first and then succeeding on the second attempt. If you succeed at everything on the first try (or never retry a failed attempt in the same context), the 'second time' never happens. Deliberately retry a failed activity/mission segment immediately to trigger it early.
trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm': fail an attempt, then succeed on the immediate retry. The cleanest way is deliberate: pick a short activity or mission segment, fail it on purpose (or let a genuine failure happen), then retry right away and succeed — the trophy registers the fail-then-succeed sequence. Players who reload saves to erase failures, or who never fail anything, can go a whole playthrough without it, so trigger it early in Stage 1 with a throwaway attempt rather than hoping it happens naturally.
steps: Start a short activity or mission segment.
Fail the first attempt (deliberately is fine).
Retry immediately and succeed.

Because the encounter is rare and easy to never trigger, it is flagged missable here: treat every strange sighting as a stop-and-watch moment.
